subject: C29
required_fixes: R1 — apps/desktop/src/v2/wizard/wizard.tsx:145-156,294-314: Cancel closes immediately whenever the snapshot has no setup, even while beginTenantSetup is pending. An independent production-Wizard probe submitted Create tenant, held its result, and clicked Cancel: onClose ran and no discard was sent. The admitted creation can therefore leave a persisted draft after cancellation. The late-discard reconciliation also stops working after an unknown result because cancelling is reset before setup disappears. Acceptance: Cancel/Escape/scrim during pending or unknown creation must reconcile admission and discard any resulting draft before closing; a later observed successful discard must close consistently. Add causal tests covering both delivery/snapshot orders and preserved active-tenant state.

R2 — crates/desktop-core/src/authority/setup_domain.rs:829-843 and authority.rs:3496-3512: discarding a draft removes its credential references and Setup but never retires its management binding/session or runtime operations. Unlike reissue_setup_context, it leaves the cached SDK clients, OAuth material and investigation alive in management_bindings; already admitted or queued ManagementJob work can continue using that binding after Cancel, including further prerequisite reads. With no subsequent active-context change, the binding remains retained. Acceptance: discard retires the draft's binding and all work under its context and workspace references, prevents queued/follow-on dispatch, withdraws late results, and releases cached authority while preserving tenant A's unrelated work. Test cancellation during blocked verification and queued workspace reads through the production interfaces.

R3 — crates/desktop-core/src/authority/setup_domain.rs:583-630: verification can hide failed sources behind Pass. Gateway considers only four list failures and ignores prerequisites.iam_plane and scope, so an IAM read denied/failed/absent can yield Pass with no warning. Red Team returns Pass whenever scans exist even when statistics_failure is present. verify_view records only warning/fail lines, so completion loses these failures entirely. Acceptance: all attempted prerequisite/source failures produce an explicit partial/failure result and retained warning; Gateway must account for its IAM binding read and Red Team for statistics. Exercise mixed-success synthetic responses and assert the completed tenant's warnings, without converting optional failures into blocking required checks.
blockers: B1 — docs/planning/chunks/C29.md and docs/planning/evidence/C29/live/blocked.json: the mandatory read-only Vulture verification receipt is absent; the approved designation does not permit the needed management read. Keep C29 blocked until the owner designates that operation and the reviewed wizard workflow produces a redacted live receipt. Synthetic acceptance cannot close this row.

That same search succeeds while a key is correctly stored, so it cannot establish Keychain deletion. The named a_tenant_created_outside_the_wizard_ends_a_first_run_draft_and_the_shell_takes_over test is absent; no draft-ID select/delete refusal test was found. ui_v2_setup_reads replaces the client with identical values and its token responder ignores submitted credentials; it does not exercise removal/re-addition or a TSG change. wizard.test.tsx tests navigation to/from Import, rather than successful import and restart.
